name: Ray&Racket
summary: Hand-tracking version of Conductor: one hand points a ray, the other holds a plane, and the target on the ray closest to the plane is selected.
howItWorks: The dominant hand's ray picks candidate targets; a plane held in the non-dominant hand acts as a depth indicator, and the candidate closest to it (within a 1 cm margin, or in front of it) is selected with a pinch. Built as a baseline for Gaze&Racket.

relationships.note: Conductor implemented with hand tracking instead of controllers.
